# Law Office of Kevin P. O'Mahony

> A healthcare law practice specializing in regulatory compliance, physician contracts, medical malpractice defense, and healthcare transactions for Atlanta Metro area providers.

Kevin P. O'Mahony is a healthcare and business litigation attorney serving the Atlanta Metro area from Suwanee, GA, with expertise in HIPAA compliance, Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute enforcement, and medical professional matters. The practice focuses on protecting healthcare providers through transactional guidance, regulatory defense, and dispute resolution.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA Compliance
- Stark Law
- Anti-Kickback Statute
- False Claims Act
- Physician Contracts
- Medical Malpractice Defense
- Healthcare Transactions
- Medical Staff Credentialing
- Practice Formation
- Non-Compete Agreements
- Alternative Dispute Resolution
- Georgia Medical Board
- Healthcare Provider Disputes
- Civil Monetary Penalties
- Regulatory Compliance

## Core Practice Areas

- [Practice Areas](https://www.komahonylaw.com/practice-areas): Overview of healthcare law, litigation, HIPAA, Stark, and Anti-Kickback services
- [Healthcare Transactions, Litigation & Alternative Dispute Resolution](https://www.komahonylaw.com/healthcare-transactions-litigation-alternative-dispute-resolution): Healthcare transactions, litigation, ADR, Stark, Anti-Kickback, and False Claims Act
- [Stark, Anti-Kickback, Civil Monetary Penalty & False Claims Act Issues](https://www.komahonylaw.com/stark-anti-kickback-civil-monetary-penalty-false-claims-act-issues): Stark Law, Anti-Kickback, False Claims Act, and HHS/OIG compliance matters
- [HIPAA, Health Information Privacy & Security Compliance](https://www.komahonylaw.com/hipaa-health-information-privacy-security-compliance): HIPAA compliance, privacy rules, business associate agreements, and PHI protection

## Physician & Healthcare Provider Services

- [Healthcare & Physician Contracts](https://www.komahonylaw.com/healthcare-physician-contracts): Physician contract negotiation, employment agreements, and non-compete review
- [Healthcare Entity & Practice Formation](https://www.komahonylaw.com/healthcare-entity-practice-formation): Medical practice formation, LLC vs S-Corp structures, and liability protection
- [Practice Sales & Acquisitions](https://www.komahonylaw.com/practice-sales-acquisitions): Medical practice sales and acquisitions with Stark Law and Anti-Kickback compliance
- [Restrictive Covenants & Non-Compete Agreements](https://www.komahonylaw.com/restrictive-covenants-non-compete-agreements): Non-compete agreements, restrictive covenants, and non-solicitation enforcement

## Medical Malpractice & Licensing Defense

- [Medical & Professional Malpractice Investigations, Defense, Litigation & ADR](https://www.komahonylaw.com/medical-professional-malpractice-investigations-defense-litigation-alternative-dispute-resolution): Medical malpractice defense, investigations, litigation, and alternative dispute resolution
- [Medical & Professional Licensing Board Matters](https://www.komahonylaw.com/medical-professional-licensing-board-matters): Georgia Medical Board defense, licensing complaints, and disciplinary representation
- [Medical Staff Credentialing, Privileges & Peer Review](https://www.komahonylaw.com/medical-staff-credentialing-privileges-peer-review): Medical staff credentialing, privileges, peer review, and HCQIA compliance
